headline: Glyphosate to be used only through trained PCOs (recommended to DA&FW); new import-permit rules for non-insecticidal uses (GSR 597(E)); no new technical imports of the organophosphates once examined for a ban; Chloropicrin turned down.

changes.t: Glyphosate: use only through trained PCOs
changes.d: After the expert committee's report the RC decided Glyphosate use should be restricted to trained personnel / Pest Control Operators, and sent this to DA&FW for a final view.

The Insecticides (Third Amendment) Rules 2026 require an import permit, in the new prescribed form, to import any scheduled substance for non-insecticidal use. Earlier RC decisions are superseded; pending permits follow the new rules.

changes.t: No fresh technical imports of certain organophosphates
changes.d: Organophosphates earlier examined for a ban will not be promoted under Technical Import (after China withdrew export VAT benefits).

changes.t: Import for Export goes in the Fast Track category
changes.d: Import-for-export files filed under the General export category were rejected; they must be filed under Fast Track. Files closed for missing Chemexcil certificates were reopened.
Chloropicrin is a highly hazardous, volatile soil fumigant; the RC kept its earlier decision and declined a presentation.

changes.t: In-process sample drawl at critical stages
changes.d: Sampling teams should watch the critical recovery stages of manufacture (e.g. Spinosad 40–68 h, Gibberellic acid 39–46 h).
Willowood's Bentazone and Haloxyfop files must give the detailed composition as in the source-country CR, apostilled, per the 470th and 472nd decisions.

BASF Alphacypermethrin + Flufenoxuron (approved with PCO-only caution), Syngenta s-Metolachlor, Deccan Florpyrauxifen-benzyl, Crystal Carfentrazone and Picoxystrobin + COC, NCVBDC on Kala-azar spraying, HIL's LLIN stock (sent to DA&FW).

changes.t: Comments on the compiled 472nd RC guidelines
changes.d: CropLife India and ACFI got 15 more days to comment on the compiled guidelines.

actions: Dual-use imports: apply in the new form under GSR 597(E).
Import for Export: file under the Fast Track category.
Glyphosate: watch for DA&FW's final notification on PCO-only use.
